summary:
Fixed the durability bug.

`SET` now appends to the WAL, calls `Sync()` before acknowledging, and only then writes the synced offset sidecar. I also changed the verification summary wording so `test.sh` does not fail on `0 LOST` while real missing keys still print `LOST key...`.

- [server.go](/workspace/server.go)
- [client.go](/workspace/client.go)
